quote_1: one of our own agents wrote candidate bugs, a second model filtered the ones it judged too easy
quote_2: ⟦T2⟧ used anonymized final patches and rationales sampled from all systems in a round.
justification: ⟦T1⟧ is the generation and model-filtering of evaluation items, whereas ⟦T2⟧ compares an evaluator's agreement with its own versus peers' anonymized outputs. These are distinct mechanisms, not variants of one another.
